title: Baseline next to a re-estimated remaining time
goal: The steps table names the baseline of an open step whose remaining time differs from it
acceptance: Open step with remaining different from baseline shows '<remaining> (planned <baseline>)' in hours and days
Always the baseline, never the previous estimate; closed and unchanged steps have no suffix
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-12 in about 0.5 agent hours (stated); baseline 0.75 agent hours judged from F-060-T01, a similar small renderer change. Remaining: PR and release.
